**Coaching note (80 words):**
When your pawn is one square from promotion with the enemy king nearby, look for a forcing pawn push with check. Here, e7+ is devastating because it's check (forcing Black to move), attacks the queen, and threatens promotion. If the king captures (Kxe7), you have an immediate back-rank mate with Qg7#.
